visualReviewNotes: Background and all five independently painted cutouts visually inspected. Actual image anchors selected for rooted stems, hanging details, tabletop objects and sky/water layers. Source alpha and contrasting-background review recorded separately. This is implementation review only; root review pending.

sources.name: background
sources.prompt: Paint a finished portrait 4:5 storybook puzzle illustration, 1280x1600 target: a cozy outdoor spice stall with copper bowls and patterned cloth sacks, close three-quarter view. Dimensional warm hand-painted digital illustration, tactile grain and woven textiles, intricate but readable natural details, soft upper-left sunlight, delightful sophisticated mobile game art. Dominant golden yellow ochre on large awning and plaster wall and the light warm market ground, tiny turquoise/red accents. No landmark, city name, text, labels, people, logos, border, UI or watermark. Stall table at lower center with beautifully distinct paprika, turmeric, pepper and cinnamon displays. A broad simple golden canvas awning stretches across the upper third with visible support beam; leave most of its lower hem plain, no pennants or tassels yet. Put an empty small cream bud vase with visible open neck on the table's right corner around x84%, y72%. Put a small understated clay pot with short bare branch at left x13%,y57%, no leaves on that one. One tied kraft-paper spice package at table front near x46%, y69%, no decorative bow on it. Fill every surface naturally, no holes or empty placeholder boxes. Clean background will later receive five independently painted details: one fabric pennant attached below the upper beam, one awning tassel, one flower sprig in the little vase, a leafy sprig rooted in the left pot, and a bow on the kraft packet. Omit those specific foreground details now, but retain all physical attachment supports.

sources.name: atlas
sources.prompt: Production transparent PNG atlas of EXACTLY FIVE hand-painted sprite cutouts in a3-column by2-row grid; bottom-right cell entirely empty. Real alpha transparency, no background/backdrop, no checkerboard painted, no letters, borders or numbers. Each object well inside cell, at least60pixels transparent gutter around entire sprite. No sprite crosses cell midpoint or image edge. Dimensional softly brushed storybook illustration, warm sunlight upperleft, delicate tactile details, not vector or photo. Separate elements for a golden ochre spice market: TOPLEFT one small saffron and muted teal triangular fabric pennant, horizontal sewn edge at top and pointed tip down, slightly windcurled; TOPMIDDLE one narrow ochre braided awning tassel with top attachment loop and frayed soft end; TOPRIGHT a tiny purple lavender sprig on a slender long green stem, bare bottom end for a vase; BOTTOMLEFT a single graceful olive-leaf sprig with a long exposed woody bottom stem for a claypot; BOTTOMMIDDLE a small cream cotton string bow tied to a kraft spice packet, loops spread sideways, short tailsdown, gently elevated threequarter view. No pot,vase,awning,packet or surroundings. Objects preserve natural shape and full silhouette.

sources.name: bow
sources.prompt: Create ONE small cotton string bow, a detailed warm storybook painted sprite with real transparent alpha PNG background. Two loose sideways loops, central knot and two short tails hangingdown, slightlyelevatedthreequarterview. Warm cream unbleachedfibers, sunlightupperleft, softpaintedshading, very delicate slimtwine, natural irregularhandtied shape. ONLY the bow. No bag, package, paper, knot support, wood, table, shadowmatte, frame, textorcheckeredbackground. Centerbowinimage with huge transparentmargin. This standalone detail will be composited onto an existing small kraftpaper spice packet.
